We are at the forefront of the ambitious Navi Mumbai International Airport (NMIA) project, a greenfield airport that will serve as the Mumbai Metropolitan Region’s second international airport.

Our Heavy Civil Infrastructure business are building India’s first High-Speed Rail Corridor, mandated to construct 237.1 km stretch MAHSR (Mumbai-Ahmedabad High-Speed Rail), C4 package involving the construction of the viaducts, stations, major river bridges, depots, and other auxiliary works, representing 46.6% of the total length making it longest amongst all the packages, running elevated from Zaroli Village on the Maharashtra – Gujarat border to Vadodara Station through 4 stations at Vapi, Bilimora, Surat and Bharuch in Gujarat.

A project of huge strategic relevance, our Heavy Civil Infrastructure business is building India’s longest river bridge connecting Dhubri in Assam to Phulbari in Meghalaya over the river Brahmaputra that will reduce the distance between the two States by 250 km and improve the connectivity of the North Eastern States with the rest of the country.
